description: What a third-party plugin window may do. This list is the sandbox: it grants the SDK's own commands and the window controls behind them, and nothing else — no file access, no activity data, no LLM key, no desktop shell. A plugin page that calls read_text_file is refused. The `remote` entry is not a remote origin in any ordinary sense: every one of these URLs is served by this app's own protocol handler, out of the plugin's own folder. It is needed because Tauri decides local-from-remote from the URL the page ended up on, and a plugin page is never on a URL Tauri counts as local — see the test in src/plugin/mod.rs for what that URL actually is and why it is not the one we asked for. It widens nothing: the window list above has to match at the same time.
